# Party cases: key

Invented text for DMbot's tests (#4537 slice 6c; Supervisor's rulings T and U). Every name and line is made up; the four player characters are the sample's, by name only. Files: [party_cases_lore.txt](party_cases_lore.txt), [party_cases_session.txt](party_cases_session.txt), [party_cases_key.json](party_cases_key.json).

| Line | Case | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | a trip ("goes to the market") | nothing |
| 3 | a trip ("stays behind to guard the wagons") | nothing |
| 4 | a question | nothing |
| 5 | another player's "left the party" (Cerric's player about Okthandom: ruling T) | nothing |
| 6 | a goodbye to someone else (the guards) | nothing |
| 7 | a plan ("will leave the party once…") | nothing |
| 8 | the DM's goodbye | Claude Ambere: a goodbye question |
| 9 | the character's own player, in the first person | Belleros Stormgrace: a goodbye question |
| 10 | no goodbye | nothing |

Each goodbye becomes one waiting question for the DM ("Has Claude left the party?"); no party stretch is closed until the DM answers, so the run's "stretches closed" must stay 0.
